messages:
mika: quick idea — wanna prototype a thin 'relnote' subcommand for the deploy bot to auto-generate release notes + pinfiles from a commit/PR range. save teams the manual bullet-chasing.

deploy-bot: thanks mika! captured as an enhancement suggestion: /deploy relnote (prototype)

sarah: yes please. can it support templates? and a --changelog-only flag for cases where we only need release notes (no deploy)?

lee: also please add rollback metadata in the output. we keep running into releases without a clear pin history to roll back to.

ana: rough CLI sketch:
```
# generate a markdown draft and a pinfile
/deploy relnote --from <shaA> --to <shaB> --template templates/relnote.md --pinfile pins.yaml --dry-run

# smaller shorthand
rel-notes gen --range HEAD~15..HEAD --format md --pin model=redwood-v2@2026-03-01
```

mika: +1 to template and dry-run. also propose a --calendar flag to attach a change-window (so release notes include the scheduled window and an iCal link).

tj: preflight idea: relnote should optionally run the preflight linter (sanity checks for migrations, feature flags, schema changes) with `--preflight` and return a pass/fail summary in the draft.

lee: UX suggestion — have the bot post the draft into the release channel with interactive checkboxes for each PR (approve / mark-for-later). approving the list can auto-publish the release note and push pins to the pinfile repo. saves copy-paste.

sarah: +emoji: :thumbsup: and add a `--no-publish` toggle. sometimes we want the draft in slack only.

ana: pinfile idea (yaml snippet):
```
- service: inference-frontend
  version: 2026-03-01-rc3
  pinned_by: mika
  reason: model-variant pin for rollout
  rollback_to: 2026-02-25
```
if the relnote generator emits this, rollout automation can consume pins directly.

deploy-bot: created INF-827: "relnote + pinflow command" — assigned to @mika and @ana, priority P2

mika: i'll prototype a small script today and push to `eng/release-scripts` — plan: relnote -> preflight -> draft in #eng-releases with interactive approve -> optional publish -> produce pins.yaml. tl;dr: relnote + pinflow + change-window + preflight dry-run + slack interactive = big time saver.

tj: if you want, i can add a minimal preflight linter rule set (checks for DB migrations and alerting hooks). i can open a PR against the prototype.

sarah: sounds great. once prototype is up i'll run it on next staging cut to see real output. can we also log which release-note templates performed best? small analytics will help ops trust the automation.

mika: perfect — i'll ping when the branch is ready. thanks all!
